title: WHAT IF YOU COULD TEST PIPELINE

segments.line: Locked out? Blink. In your room? Late for class?
Blink. In your seat? Rooftop sunset? Blink.
On the edge. What if you could teleport anywhere you've seen?
One catch. Earth rotates at a thousand miles an hour.
Teleport between latitudes and you hit the ground at 500 miles an hour.
That's real. So, which way are you facing?
